meta_description: Cove Carpentry Ltd offers expert carpentry in Leicester. Bespoke joinery, fitted furniture & more. Quality craftsmanship guaranteed. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Skilled Leicester Carpenters — Free Quotes Available
hero_subhead: Need reliable carpentry in Leicester? We deliver precise, lasting craftsmanship — on time and within budget, every time.
services_subhead: From bespoke fitted furniture to structural joinery, Cove Carpentry delivers skilled, reliable solutions for homes and businesses throughout Leicester.

services.title: Bespoke Fitted Wardrobes
services.desc: Maximise your bedroom space with fully bespoke fitted wardrobes, designed and built to your exact dimensions and style. Every unit is crafted from quality materials and finished to a high standard.

services.title: Kitchen Fitting
services.desc: We supply and fit kitchens of all sizes, handling everything from unit installation to worktop cutting and finishing. You get a seamless, professionally fitted kitchen without the hassle.

services.title: Staircase Renovation
services.desc: Transform tired staircases with new treads, risers, spindles, and handrails tailored to your home. Our staircase work combines structural integrity with a clean, attractive finish.

services.title: Door Hanging & Fitting
services.desc: Internal and external doors hung accurately first time, eliminating draughts, rattles, and sticking. We work with all door types including fire doors, bi-folds, and French doors.

services.title: Skirting Boards & Architrave
services.desc: Crisp, perfectly mitred skirting boards and architrave that give any room a polished, finished look. We match existing profiles or install entirely new designs to suit your décor.

services.title: Loft Conversions & Structural Joinery
services.desc: From loft boarding and flooring to structural timber frameworks, we handle the carpentry element of your conversion with precision. All work complies with current building regulations.

about_pullquote: We take pride in every joint, every finish, and every satisfied customer.
about_para_1: Cove Carpentry Ltd was established to bring genuine craftsmanship back to carpentry in Leicester. Based at Pilgrim House in the heart of the city, we've spent years building a reputation for quality work delivered with honesty and care. Our team holds the skills and experience to tackle everything from small domestic repairs to large bespoke joinery projects.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is simple: we treat every home and every client with the same level of attention, whether it's a single door hang or a complete fitted furniture installation. Our customers return to us time and again — and they recommend us to friends and family — because we get things right first time and stand behind every job we complete.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Cove Carpentry

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant job on our fitted wardrobes. The finish is immaculate and they were tidy, punctual, and a pleasure to have in the house. Would recommend Cove Carpentry to anyone in Leicester without hesitation.
reviews.author: Rachel T.

reviews.text: Had them fit a new staircase and hang several internal doors throughout the house. Fantastic quality, very fair price, and they left the place spotless. Already booked them back for a kitchen fitting next month.
reviews.author: Mark H.

reviews.text: Really impressed from start to finish. Turned up when they said they would, explained everything clearly, and the skirting boards and architrave look perfect. It's rare to find tradespeople this reliable these days.
reviews.author: Susan B.
